She leans forward, lifts the handbag over the tabletop with her left hand and lowers it until its base rests flat on the table near the left end; her fingers open and release the handle, and the handbag stays exactly where she placed it for the rest of the shot. After the handbag is set down she takes two small steps and turns to face the camera and the girl, bringing her front with the small red mark on her left chest into view. She raises her right hand, palm open and fingers together, and extends it toward the girl and the handbag in a welcoming gesture, nods once, and holds the gesture. Both women keep their hands, fingers and feet clearly visible, and each keeps her own face, hair and clothes. The white vase of red ginger flowers and the small brochure stand stay fixed on the table. The camera stays still, level and at the same framing throughout. Footsteps tap on the floor and the handbag lands with a soft thud. These two women are the only people in the room, and every surface keeps the painted PS2 look of <Subject 1>.
